text:
Ava: Quick handoff: I'm going to prune some low-value alerts in the alert map and bump priority on the 503 spike rule. Doing this to reduce pager fatigue during the late-night window. Link to the planned diff: https://go/redwood/alerts/PR-4821 :memo:

Jamal: Can you call out which thresholds change? we still need a wakeup for real service regressions. :eyes:

Ava: Good call. TL;DR: keep service-availability alerts at current sensitivity. Reduce noisy infra transient alerts:
```yaml
- name: gpu-temp-warning
  severity: P3
  threshold: 85C -> 88C
- name: short-tail-oom
  severity: P3
  consolidate_window: 5m -> 10m
- name: http-503-spike
  severity: P2
  rate_threshold: 1.5% -> 2.0%
```
These changes are only for the oncall midnight->6am window, and we'll route P2 to #eng-oncall and P1 to #pager.

Liu: Can we test the routing in staging first? I'd like to run a synthetic 503 spike to validate fallback routing. I can schedule at 01:30 PT.

Ava: Yes — that's the plan. I'll push the PR to staging now and schedule the test with you. If staging looks good, we roll to prod at 03:00 PT with a 30m observation window.

Sara: For clarity, do we want SEV2 (P2) to page oncall during the night or just post to #eng-oncall? Last time P2 woke the rotation.

Ava: Night policy: P2 posts to #eng-oncall (no page) unless it crosses a second metric (error rate AND latency) — then escalation to pager occurs. This is documented in the PR description.

ops-bot: CONFIG-DEPLOYMENT: staging-alerts updated by Ava (PR-4821) — staging rollout started. See deploy log: https://ci.redwood/builds/7892

Jamal: If the staging test passes, I'll approve the prod rollout. Who's on standby if something weird shows up during the 30m window?

Ava: Jamal and Liu on standby. I'll be around for the first 10m to validate dashboards then switch to monitoring. Ping @Sara if escalation needed.

Liu: I'll run the synthetic at 01:30, report back in thread with a quick snapshot of the alert flow.

Sara: Thanks — sounds good. Please add a one-line change note in #eng-sre so infra knows why thresholds shifted. :+1:

Ava: Noted. I'll post a short note and link to the PR. Final: PR #4821 — target prod rollout 03:00 PT, rollback plan in the description, and I'll tag oncall rotation post-rollout.

Jamal: 👍

Liu: On it.
